_comment: What it costs an Age's instability budget to be set alight (design 5.0, 5.2).
Priced with the sandfall, the blizzard and the meteor storm, on the argument all four share: this is
difficulty you can answer rather than a verdict you cannot. Fire goes out in rain by vanilla's own
rule, so an inflicted inferno in a wet Age is a nuisance and in a dry one is a siege -- and which of
those it is falls out of the Age's own climate rather than out of anything written here.
`most` is ONE, where its three neighbours are four. They each buy a designed ramp -- how often, how
long, how hard -- and an inferno has none: what a written one does is a fact about the sun rather than
a dial. So this either happens or it does not, which is a complete thing to say. A ramp would have to
be designed in `Inferno.burn` before it could be priced here.
